title: RAGFlow Canvas -- T1059 unsandboxed Jinja2 SSTI in citation prompt generator
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin observed rules (derived from breach corpus)
description:
Vendor-disclosed detection for CVE-2026-45312 (GHSA-wpg4-h5g2-jxm6,
CVSS 9.9 CRITICAL), a self-reported advisory for RAGFlow, an
open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation engine.

In 0.24.0 and earlier, `rag/prompts/generator.py:185` constructs prompt
templates with an unsandboxed Jinja2 environment
(`PROMPT_JINJA_ENV = jinja2.Environment(autoescape=False, ...)`).
`citation_prompt()` (line 189) renders a `user_defined_prompts` value
populated from the LLM component's `sys_prompt`
`<CITATION_GUIDELINES>` field through this environment. Any authenticated
user (self-registration is open by default, so this includes a brand-new
low-privilege account) can create a Canvas workflow chaining a
DuckDuckGo search component (no API key required) into an LLM component
with `cite=true` (the default) to reach this code path via
`POST /v1/canvas/set` (save the workflow) and `POST /v1/canvas/completion`
(execute it). The advisory's own PoC payload escapes the template
sandbox entirely via Jinja2's object-graph traversal:
`{% set g = cycler.__init__.__globals__ %}{% set bl = g.__builtins__ %}
{% set os = bl.__import__('os') %}{{ os.popen('id > /tmp/pwned').read() }}`
-- placed inside `<CITATION_GUIDELINES>` tags in the `sys_prompt` field.
No patched version exists as of this rule's authoring (advisory lists
"Patched versions: None").

Detection logic flags the specific object-graph-traversal primitives
that make Jinja2 SSTI payloads work regardless of exact payload wording
-- `__globals__`, `__builtins__`, `__import__`, `__subclasses__`, and
`__mro__` are Jinja2/Python sandbox-escape idioms with no legitimate
reason to appear inside a citation-guidelines prompt field.

Aggregated from 1 first-party vendor security advisory (infiniflow, via
GHSA and NVD). No fix available at authoring time -- deployers should
restrict Canvas creation to trusted users or disable self-registration
until a patch ships.
